description: The payload for creating a transition in a workflow. Can be DIRECTED, GLOBAL, SELF-LOOPED, GLOBAL LOOPED

actions.description: The actions that are performed when the transition is made

customIssueEventId.description: Mechanism in Jira for triggering certain actions, like notifications, automations, etc. Unless a custom notification scheme is configure, it's better not to provide any value here

from.description: The statuses that the transition can be made from

triggers.description: The triggers that are performed when the transition is made

validators.description: The validators that are performed when the transition is made
